answer.worked: The dotted parabola has a zero at $x=\frac12$, so the reciprocal has vertical asymptote $x=\frac12$. The parabola is positive on either side of its zero, so both reciprocal branches lie above the $x$-axis. As $x\to\frac12^\pm$, $y\to+\infty$; as $x\to\pm\infty$, $y\to0^+$. The point $(0,1)$ remains $(0,1)$. Correct answer: B.
